title: Cambrian geological record along the Transantarctic Mountains
note: Observations, not model output: rock units and their published ages and settings. Localities are approximate points chosen by this project to mark each area (about ±100 km); they are carried to the past with the plate under them, which is the model's part. Ages use the ICS chart v2023/09 for the series and stages the sources name. Compiled 2026-11-12.

where.ko: 중부 남극종단산맥, 버드 빙하–홀리오크 산맥 일대
where.en: Central Transantarctic Mountains, Byrd Glacier–Holyoake Range area

what.ko: 캄브리아기 제2세(3–4절)의 탄산염 대륙붕 퇴적층. 조간대에서 폭풍파 기저까지의 환경을 기록하고, 고배류(archaeocyath)–미생물 초(礁)를 포함한다. 위쪽은 대륙붕이 깊어진 뒤 조산 퇴적물에 덮인다.
what.en: Cambrian Series 2 (Stages 3–4) carbonate shelf deposits, recording settings from intertidal to storm-wave base, with archaeocyath–microbial reefs. Its top records the shelf deepening and then burial under orogenic sediment.

refs: Debrenne, F., and Kruse, P. D., 1986. Shackleton Limestone archaeocyaths. Alcheringa, 10, 235–278.

Myrow, P. M., Pope, M. C., Goodge, J. W., Fischer, W., and Palmer, A. R., 2002. Depositional history of pre-Devonian strata and timing of Ross orogenic tectonism in the central Transantarctic Mountains, Antarctica. GSA Bulletin, 114, 1070–1088.

what.ko: 중기 캄브리아기(먀오링절 중·후반) 탄산염층, 400 m 넘는 두께. 바닥은 육성 골짜기 메움 퇴적층이고 그 위가 얕은 바다 탄산염이다. 삼엽충은 오스트레일리아·중국 쪽과 가깝다.
what.en: Middle Cambrian (mid to late Miaolingian) carbonates over 400 m thick, above a non-marine valley fill at the base. Its trilobites are close to Australian and Chinese forms.

refs: Palmer, A. R., and Gatehouse, C. G., 1972. Early and Middle Cambrian trilobites from Antarctica. U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 456-D.
Evans, K. R., Rowell, A. J., and Rees, M. N., 1995. Sea-level changes and stratigraphy of the Nelson Limestone (Middle Cambrian), Neptune Range, Antarctica.

what.ko: 고태평양 쪽 대륙 가장자리의 섭입으로 생긴 대륙 화성호. 북빅토리아 랜드에서 저어콘 U–Pb 연대로 약 520–480 Ma의 여러 마그마 활동이 나온다. 변형은 전기 캄브리아기에 시작됐다.
what.en: A continental arc above subduction on the palaeo-Pacific margin. In northern Victoria Land, zircon U–Pb ages give magmatic pulses from about 520 to 480 Ma. Deformation began in the Early Cambrian.

says.en: A mountain belt growing above subduction (observed)

refs: Goodge, J. W., 2020. Geological and tectonic evolution of the Transantarctic Mountains, from ancient craton to recent enigma. Gondwana Research, 80, 50–122.
